investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Coppervid Studios (online gaming); Platform: Microsoft Azure eastus2 (zones eastus2-1/eastus2-2/eastus2-3); network range 10.141.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster copper-prod-eastus (AKS); Database: players-db-01 holds players records; Automation: data-retention workflows scheduled by Argo Workflows and executed under service accounts (runs recorded with RUN- identifiers); Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
